identity: Speargrass Reach cuts the Throng's spears from its grass; vultures, tigers and a goblin banner-broker cut into the harvest.

quests.title: Morga Knows the Missing Colours
quests.text: Crews come home asking whether I have seen the banners they left with, as if I might have packed them away with the supper pots. Speak to Morga Cutgrass at Cutgrass Watch about the missing colours. She is collecting the reports, and she remembers who stood beneath each one.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Promises Outlast Breath
quests.text: I keep the names of everyone who goes out with our crews, including those who do not come back to answer. Take word of that work to Ossa Quietregister in Nhal Veyr. Our promises to those people should not depend on whether they can still remind us.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Put the Claws to Work
quests.text: The Tallgrass Tigers of the {name:tallgrass} cut through tough grass with equipment they never have to order. Bring me three Shearing Cat Claws so I can try them as tool tips. If the trial works, the next shift can borrow the idea without borrowing the whole cat.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Gates for the Crew Yard
quests.text: People keep cutting through the crew yard wherever they please, which makes counting a returning shift a lively exercise. Bring me four Acacia Wood Fence Gates so I can give them proper ways in and out. I want to know who is home before the bowls go round.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Bring the Colours Home
quests.text: A bundle of stolen banners has been left at the {name:banner_cache} in the {name:hunting_grounds}. Secure it and report to me so we can return the colours to the people who carried them. They should not have to buy back the cloth their friends stood under.
quests.completion: Those colours can go home. I know people who will recognise every patched tear in them.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Our Colours Are Not for Sale
quests.text: Goblin Banner-Broker Rakk steals banners and offers to sell them back to their own bearers. Kill him at the {name:goblin_camp}, {dir_from_giver:goblin_camp}, and bring me word. He prices each one by how much its people want it back; I know exactly what sort of merchant that makes him.
quests.completion: Rakk's trade is finished. I will tell the crews they owe him nothing for wanting their colours back.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Stand Where the Ash Falls
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise needs people willing to stand with the watch when the ash falls. Go and speak to her about the work. She will have more use for your hands than for a grand account of why you came.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
